/* selectMasterMdCmStndCatalogConfirmList */ SELECT X.CMS_CATLG_ID AS CMS_CATLG_ID, X.DESCRIPTION_LOC, X.DESCRIPTION_ENG, X.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, Z1.CATEG_PATH, X.MODEL_INFO, X.STD_FLAG, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M104' AND CODE = X.MAKER_CODE) AS MAKER_NAME, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = X.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_NAME, X.ORDER_MEASURE AS ORDER_MEASURE, X.REMARK AS REMARK, X.CMS_CATEG_ID AS CMS_CATEG_ID, X.MAKER_CODE AS MAKER_CODE, X.ORIGIN_CODE AS ORIGIN_CODE, X.STD_FLAG AS STD_FLAG, X.ITEM_GUBUN AS ITEM_GUBUN, X.STATUS, (SELECT COD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'CA01' AND COD.CODE =X.STATUS) AS STATUS_NM, X.IMGFILE_NAME, X.IMGFILE_DIR, X.DETAIL_IMGFILE_NAME, X.DETAIL_IMGFILE_DIR, NVL2(TRIM(X.IMGFILE_DIR||X.IMGFILE_NAME) , 'https://keps3.koreab2b.com/'||X.IMGFILE_DIR|| '/' ||X.IMGFILE_NAME, '/resources/images/icon_emptyimg.gif') AS IMG, NVL2 (TRIM(X.DETAIL_IMGFILE_NAME||X.DETAIL_IMGFILE_NAME) , 'https://keps3.koreab2b.com/'||X.DETAIL_IMGFILE_DIR|| '/' ||X.DETAIL_IMGFILE_NAME, '/resources/images/icon_emptyimg.gif') AS IMG_DT, X.ADD_DATE, X.ADD_USER_ID, (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = X.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_NM FROM CMSCATLG X, CMSCATEG Z1 WHERE X.CMS_CATEG_ID = Z1.CMS_CATEG_ID AND X.ADD_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} AND X.STATUS = 'S'
AND X.CMS_CATLG_ID LIKE #{st_cms_catlg_id}||'%'
AND X.DESCRIPTION_LOC LIKE #{st_description}||'%'
AND X.SPECIFICATION LIKE #{st_spec}||'%'
AND X.MODEL_INFO LIKE #{st_model_info}||'%'
ORDER BY X.CMS_CATLG_ID
